ai_review.summary: Very good soundboard recording (rare source) with solid audio quality, but no performance details provided.
ai_review.review: Reviewers praise the overall sound quality as very good and note that this is a rare upgrade over previous copies. The recording sounds clear despite a few cuts, though there are no comments on how the band performed that night.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review, which is positive about the audio but gives no insight into the musical performance; good recording quality lifts the rating modestly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very good overall sound quality with a few cuts; rare source makes it a nice upgrade.
